lairs.Orcs.flavour.en: They burn what they cannot carry. Every night the war drums draw closer to the town.

lairs.Harpies.flavour.en: Anything that shines is theirs by morning. The market has learned to trade in the dark.

lairs.Goblins.flavour.en: They tunnel under the yards and come up where the tools are. Nothing heavy is safe.

lairs.WolfRiders.flavour.en: They ride in at dawn, take the flocks and are gone before the dust settles.

lairs.Drake.flavour.en: It sleeps on a hill of gold and wakes hungry for more. The treasury is its larder.
